cases.name: guard-true-selects-arm
cases.body:
let x:E=Data(5)
return match x {Data(p) when p>0=>p,Data(_)=>0,Empty=>0}
cases.cs: E x=new Data(5); return x switch {Data d when d.p>0=>d.p,Data d=>0,Empty=>0};
cases.extra: class E{} class Data:E{public int p;public Data(int p){this.p=p;}} class Empty:E{}

cases.name: guard-runs-only-on-match

return match x {Data(p) when p>10=>1,Data(p) when p>0=>2,Data(_)=>3,Empty=>0}

cases.name: guard-call-bool
cases.body:
let x:E=Data(1)
return match x {Data(p) when nice()=>p,Data(_)=>0,Empty=>0}
cases.pre:
type E=Data(int)|Empty
fn nice()->bool ensures true {return true}
cases.cs: bool Nice()=>true; E x=new Data(1); return x switch {Data d when Nice()=>d.p,Data d=>0,Empty=>0};
cases.extra: class E{} class Data:E{public int p;public Data(int p){this.p=p;}} class Empty:E{}

cases.name: guard-arithmetic-condition
cases.body:

return match x {Data(p) when p%2==0=>p*2,Data(q)=>q,Empty=>0}
cases.cs: E x=new Data(4); return x switch {Data d when d.p%2==0=>d.p*2,Data d=>d.p,Empty=>0};
cases.extra: class E{} class Data:E{public int p;public Data(int p){this.p=p;}} class Empty:E{}
